determinism.note: Instances are regenerated in worker subprocesses from their parameters and seed, so a worker and its driver build bit-identical graphs without serialising them.

censored_representation.separation: realised_separation is null with realised_separation_status carrying the reason; never encoded as a number such as 0 or -1
censored_representation.radius: UNREACHED is -1 and is a sentinel, never averaged or plotted numerically

assumption_status.radius: exact under Conjecture 2, hence Anti-Exchange Case B (verified, not proved). Its error direction makes radii TOO LARGE, which is FAVOURABLE to this session's hypothesis -- stated wherever the refutation is claimed
assumption_status.gac_forbidden_set_mpdag: verified against enumeration (74,568 exhaustive + 2,419,520 sampled, 0 disagreements) but not proved exact; over-approximation would make radii too small, the conservative direction here
assumption_status.theorem_14: proved: O is disjoint from de(X), and on such sets the two criteria coincide
assumption_status.fast_gate: strictly stricter than runner.gate on one check; 16/46,800 (0.034%), and the exclusions are maximally-robust instances, biasing against the hypothesis
